text: Libertex Group was co-founded in 1997 by Vyacheslav Taran, who served as its Chairman of the Board until his death in a helicopter crash en route to Monaco on 25 November 2022.

source.name: FX News Group - Libertex official statement on passing of Chairman Viacheslav Taran
source.quote: In 1997, he co-founded what was to eventually become the trading and investing platform Libertex.
